svg.title: Played-game relationships and active-session counts
svg.desc:
First (player, game) play → deduplicated played relationship → game player set ↑ User query → friend graph / friend IDs → set intersection → friend-played count
Session start / heartbeat / end → per-player-game active reference state ↓ last-session expiry / first start total active players per game
